messages.subject: gl.report.pa.pop not functioning?

messages.author: b3d929c6746ca81a
messages.subject: RE: [dartR] gl.report.pa.pop not functioning?
parts:
Hi Adam,

 

Can you check please which version of adegenet you are on?

 

packageVersion(“adegenet”)   #Version 2.1.1 is broken. If you have that update adegenet.

 

and also which version of dartR you are using.

 

packageVersion(“dartR”)

 

There is the new version 1.8.3 available via

 

library(devtools)

install_github(“green-striped-gecko/dartR”)

 

 

as it works for me with the new version.

 

Btw  gl.report.pa.pop is now replaced by gl.report.pa
